notes.title: Space Travel Update (Beta Branch)
notes.notes:
[h3]New Features:[/h3][list][*][p]Space Travel with testing destinations! You can now travel to another space sector, but you must know your destination coordinates, there is a new 5 digit coordinate system.  You might find some coordinates, or someone can mention them, then you can use them in your ship to find the location. Science Camp can be visited this way (The game will tell you how to do space travel).
Once you enter space travel you cannot stear, you can only stop the travel, Some NPCs can explan the system to you.[/p][/*][*][p]Network can now share inputs with other networks, even networks of other type. I mostly needed it for ship's control panels, Player could in the future buy better control panel and easily replace it by attaching 2 cables, instead of 20. I also did this because I want to re-use ships control panels, so I don't have to update all ships when new features are added.[/p][/*][*][p]New damage direction indicator , it's linked to damage caused by personal conflict and vacuum damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Stealth approach is now more usable because you are not noticed instantly, instead there is a progress bar above enemy's head of how aware of you he is (works only when trespassing), movement speed and crouch state matters[/p][/*][*][p]I realized I can use my quest system and most of it's functions to also do NPC routines, Max is experiomental for this, instead of walking all over the place, he's got points he  checkes and then goes for a break to emergenmcy room. Routines are meant to be  interupted by  emergency situations or quests.  I do not intent to do NPC life simulator, I want this mostly for patrols and occasionaly for something cool for some special NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs now have initial location and when you get respawned, they are teleported to it, and their health is reset if it's non zero and if not in the coma.[/p][/*][*][p]When you were attempting to clear enemy area and things go wrong and you respawn, enemies are revived by neraby friends if there are still any left, otherwise, the remain in coma. (same logic applies when you leave the sector and return)[/p][/*][*][p]There is a new Stealth testing bounty quest, in different Sector (station there is ultra basic, just plain walls, its only for testing)[/p][/*][*][p]When member of some group of NPCs adds someone as an enemy, enemy status is shared with all members of the group.[/p][/*][*][p]Text Display can be tuned to display specific array index value (used to show only first index)[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Items:[/h3][list][*][p]Added AstroCompass! When provided with coordinates. it guides towards the coordinates.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Text Display S (half width)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Changes:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Stations Test map is now the main game. Science camp and Planet survival map were moved to test maps. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Under the hood changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Dialogs are no longer stored in the world objects (as other quest  invisible objects), instead all possible dialogs for the certain NPC is stored inside the NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Devices that consume power no longer take all power available,  they take only what they are designed for[/p][/*][*][p]Thrust of Liquid thrusters is not necessarily limited by valves before the thruster, the pipe connection now carries one analog input (in shor better control for ship builder )
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugs Fixed:[/h3][list][*][p]Lot of path following issues ware happening because I assumed that I can remove first point of the path because I taught thats where the NPC alreay is. (That's actually where the nearest navigation point is, and the NPC could be several meters far)[/p][/*][*][p]Some path following issues were caused because measuring collision between NPC and GoalTarget location often skipped the last 50 cm, sometimes wall could have been there, while function returned clear straight path.[/p][/*][*][p]NPC no longer checks if he should jump at the position infront of him, instead it check in the direction of the path, it will hopefuly reduce jumping and getting stuck on stairs's railing.[/p][/*][*][p]Bounty quests now have "follow switch" in dialog, when NPCs decide to go with you[/p][/*][*][p]Only one instance of journal can be opened now[/p][/*][*][p]Sitting on toilet fixed[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs can now operate  normal (non electric) doors like Steel bars door[/p][/*][*][p]When player tried to lock the lock, it only worked when E was pressed really quckly, or the lock was locked again[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Please tell me what you find the most lacking about the main game. Thank you[/p]

notes.title: Space Stations Update is in Beta!
notes.notes:
[h3]New Space Stations test map[/h3]
I am really axcited to let you play what I have been working on last 6 months.
The new map includes 2 bigger stations, one smaller station and two tiny stations.
3 new ships , 2 jobs to make money, shops to spend them. Side Quest to get your own ship, another  Side quest with some small story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/6ed63f45029c3d2a85002eaf31fe8ac0c8874069.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Features:[/h3][list]
[*]Mop cleaning, cargo container manipulation in Zero G, shopping , (I don't want to tell more about it so you can report how intuitive it is, thanks.)
Keys, locks, keycards. Lock Works the same as keypad, but you need an item instead of memorized code.
[*]Utility shaft doors, hidden doors, floor utility doors, (these non motororized doors can be unlocked/locked/open without lock or button part attached to it)
[*]Reworked Character system and model that now supports females, and muscles/fat/nice curves on both genders. For now there are just few presets no customization yet, . 
[*]Some Stealth and thief features are implemented, NPCs will spam the chat to let you know that they know, or start following you but nothing else.
They dislike your trespassing, or when you grab their items, or put them in your inventory.
[*]Metal parts can have rusty look, with various rust level.
[*]Icons in the corner popup to notify you about crouching, trespassing, Gravity
[*]Better third person ship controls thanks to the ability to lock/unlock the ship  with contextual button, or info about state of the switches, so for example you know if your dock magnet is active or not.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/6f70a68cd37dbec2a41f7d098bf2d39624145b70.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Items:[/h3][list]
[*]5 directinal small thruster.  Two of them on opposite sides can make it possible for the ship go any direction, good for small ships, so they can be simple and still functional.
[*]Steel Wall parts have new variations, with wall side removed, so the structure inside is exposed, making more detailed and industrial look.)
[*]Shaft Doors and Trapdoors added. Used for accesing shafts/vents if you want to play stealthy, or when you need an access to a shaft, for a legitimate reasons.
(are operated by hand, no electricity or buttons)
[*]Cloths added, few pants, labor overalls, formal shoes,
[*]Lot of decorative objects for walls were added, but there no means for player to craft them or use them now, they are only on my default builds.
[*]Gravity generator, I made it in the way that it works only on an object that has floor below and ceiling above.  so it cannot cause trouble when you are near the station outside. When you under its influence Icon pops up in the corner, 
[*]Locks, Keys, Keycards, keycard locks. There is also special kind of lock that requires the key to stay inside to stay unlocked.
[/list]


[h3]Changes:[/h3][list]
[*]You can nurse back to health people in coma, If you keep their health, hunger, thirst and energy up, their coma is gonna go away slowly until they wake up.
[*]It turned out to be desirible to be able to crouch in zero g, so its possible now, but it needed its own key since ctrl is used to go down.
Cable mode now uses X key, and by tradition, Crouch is switched by C key.
[*]Doors that have lock/keypad attached, but no button, are opened/closed when key is entered, 
[/list] 


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
Path finding system can now work with custom abilities of each character thats searching path. If chacracter for whatever reason cannot open doors,
door path is blocked unless the door is currently open.
Doors turned out to by tricky in my game, because you might or might not have buttons or keypads on door, and even each side of the door can be diferent.
So the path finder has to check if character has means to open it from desired side of the door, and also knowledge, like needed pass codes.

I have rewrittent pathfinding to C++ long time ago, but now I also rewrote environment scanning to C++, which builds pathfinding network,
it no longer kills performance, but it still has impact (if the game runs 60 fps where CPU is the bottleneck, it runs above 54 fps when scanning is active. This new scanning creates way less connections than before, only necessary ones, so the pahfinding is faster too, )

I had to make my own path finder because the default one in Unreal Engine is good for static flat worlds, but i need pathfinder that can have floor on any direction, or on moving ship.

I have made lot optimizations to Characters. Decorations and cables dissapear with distance
Please tell me about your framerate on the new map.

[h3]Missing features that will be totally there hopefully soon:[/h3]
There is a station designed to work as a ship repair station, but no auto repairs for money yet, however there is a workshop, where you can do minor repairs manually by yourself. 
No tutorials for anything yet, let the contextual messages guid you. There will be basic electronics course and ship pilot school, similar to whta is in the Science Camp

Next updates will most likely make your progress on the new map obsolete, but I will try to make a way to transfer money

Thank you very much for recent suggestions,  If you have any ideas I'll be glad to hear it

[i]Known Issues: 1/3 of characters have wrong hair or other features[/i]

notes.title: Inventory and Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
I decided to make some things right before releasing huge Space Stations update.


[h3]Improvements and changes:[/h3][list]
[*]Player's main and additional storage has an extra inventory panel now,
When you press the keybord key thats used for qetting an item out,
you can uninstall selected "extra storage". No need to go to character slots UI.
This new panel also shows fullness percentage. Can hide/expand contents
[*]You can add extra storage by pressing contextual button when just by looking at the storage.
[*]Survival tutorial now has lot of restrictions at the very beginning, so you can do only the action that is required (there was lot of confusion because most of the players did many things by accident correctly)
First few steps were reworked and changed.
[*]Third person camera collides with walls and is smoother
[*]Tool is now using right mouse button (instead of "Middle mouse button"). Most people were uncomfortable using middle button very often. Middle button now equips tool in inventory
[*]Storage menu item manipulation is now mainly controlled by left mouse button, also is now possible to  move items within same inventory just to change order
[*]Storage menu item manipulation now uses "drag and drop" instead of "click, drag, click"
[*]Lot of primitive crafts need less materials.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/eb6bf33dbe3cc0ea092f5b8db84be9b167556d74.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bugs fixed:[/h3][list]
[*]Buttons levers etc, can be finally only operated when its top side is facing player camera
[*]Some fixes associated with new direct adding to inventory with interaction
[*]Storage UI fixes: Keybord key ESC in UIs,  lingering item icon on mouse.
[*]Character Slots UI now shows cloth item icons
[*]Invetory selection indicator no longer dissapears
[*]Grass and bush works again after harvesting and regrowing.
[/list]

Because I work for several exciting months on Space Stations update, I forgot about survival, and thats good, thanks to that, I was able to see some illogical things when I was trying to play it recently.


Please tell me what you think about the UI changes, Tutorial changes, and tell me please what was your experience when playing survival tutorial for the first time. Thank you very much

notes.title: Big Bug fix
notes.notes:
[h3]Very bad bug Fixed:[/h3]
All new players (or Players who never changed anything in the settings) had empty planet without any stones and nature parts. (because  even default setting were applied only when settings file was found)
I am very sorry for this bug.

Space Stations update is very close, but I was forced to bring you some new stuff right now, becasue I needed to fix that nasty bug, some things were changed or improved and cannot work like they used to,

[list][h3]New Items[/h3]
[*]Space Suit and Space helmet added!
[*]Locker Added. Stores outfit and player an swap outfit with one button without going to any menu
[/list]

[list][h3]Changes:[/h3]
[*]Vacuum is much more dangerous without spacesuit than it was, and air stays longer when space suit and spacehelmet is equiped.(air tanks will come later).
[*]Item under your cursor can be directly added to inventory by pressing "E" (only when the part is not attached to anything, or when part has some interaction)
[*]Input parts (buttons, sliders ) can no longer be operated, when not attached to anything.
[*]Rocks and other pickable nature items can be also picked directly into the inventory by "E".
[*]In zeroG, pressing shift is used for orientation and alt is for full stop (it it was other way around, and it  slowed down the player when Zero G was entered while spriting)
[*]In ZeroG movement, pressing Right shift changes your orientation to nearest floor, no longer needed to point at surface and press mouse
[*]ZeroG movement is more responsive, much faster acceleration, but it has max speed now, whitch is purposelly quite slow (bit faster than sprinting), you can still fly around moving ship that exceeds your max speed, because i did some aditional math and value saving (but once you slow down certain thershold, you cannot catch the ship).
[/list]

Only place where you can see the new stuff is first few space missions at Science camp. After all the changes, it was 3 days of work to make science camp working as it used to.

Please tell me what you think abou new ZeroG controls, or other changes. Thank you

notes.title: Info about "Space-Stations" Update
notes.notes:
I am sorry the update is taking longer than I promised, My favourite job is doing technical stuff for the game, but that was no longer the priority. It was time to make space stations,  rooms and pretty stuff. But unfortunately, I am really not the right guy for this kind of tasks. Weeks passed and I felt really un-inspired, unable to do anything, I started to work on decoaration system again so its actually usable, and good with performance, (I always counted with this decorative objects, thats the reason why walls are so plain, and simple on its own, They were meant to be decorated)  I added lot of decorative objects for the walls. When I did that I actually came up with some wall designs I kinda liked , I was Inspired again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/e98e4ea00fef676d6f5ca304dab486b8b92341e7.jpg[/img]

However, the inspiration did not last long, I was unable to make one whole space-station all these empty rooms made me un inspired. Then I decided I should make furniture and it really helped to find some inspiration for style and contents of the rooms at the space station.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/1e0598741434e4401c0aa841cd3fd957f74f4aa0.png[/img]
Furniture at its core is mindles rig with basic shapes, mean to be populated with decoration parts, for example cauch is using tens of them, but gameplay wise they are manipulated as one with its object and can be placed as a whole into the inventory. I do things this way because I am hoping that players could do custom decorating one day, but only if they want I dont want to force it. Any piece of decoration can have almost any material that is in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/7376b32dd6e9c6ad4dcc727da3ab0771a006c6c7.jpg[/img]

The furniture has it's technical side too, closets and drawers have inventory and couch can be sit on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/013865d20e7f50151e4ae47ab15c47131815b044.jpg[/img]

There is also a happy reason why the update is taking longer, I have some new gameplay features that I didn't even promised but I made them anyway, and also 2 repeatable new jobs that are using some of these features. I will tell you about it when they actually  came out as an update

I have to do some things before update can be released, I have  a fuel station with motel in it, but I need another space station so there is a reason to use ships, and I need some other points of interest in space. I am open to ideas for points of interest, and for repeatable jobs or sidequest given by NPCs. (Nothing that that involves fighting please. Fighting will be in some big update hopefully by june).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/40eef6c2a0f19fbbf8797163a571705aeb85337a.jpg[/img]

If someone brings me some really good idea which I can actually use,  that person will be in some form in game's credits. Kastuk earned that already repatedly over and over. Thank you Kastuk.

List of Furniture types that can have unique purpose in game, I am open to suggestions, thanks
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/a20e92655ddc8c9e9fd218b34e6fcac1e6536599.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ancient bug fix! (Only in BETA)
notes.notes:
[h3]Ancient Bugs were fixed:[/h3][list]
[*]All bugs related to "unloding game back to menu and then loading another game", should be now fixed, Because I no longer try to destroy everything manualy and reset all variables by myself, I simply load empty UnrealEngine level again. No such bugs should appear again in the future when I add new variables to the game. (I forgot I have this option, because  due to large complexity of the game I use my own level save system, not built-in one. But built-in method is still unmatched for flushing everything)
[*]Harvesting bug: Nature clusters had some duplicate metadata indexes, so the harvesting often resulted in wrong item, or no item at all
[/list]


[h3]Bugs Fixed:[/h3][list]
[*]Using axe on Wood cutting rig, created smaller parts than it should, or even invisible parts that caused other problems.
[*]Plans are now visible after loading, if they were visible when game was saved. 
[*]Plans lost building progress after loading.
[*]If equip button was pressed when selected inventory item couldn't be equiped, nothing happend (that's good), but later when player scrolled to some item that could be equiped,
it was equiped automaticly, (that's bad.)
[*]Some part were always forbiden to place or drop, saying "doesn't fit"
[*]Controls for pouring molten metal are visible again
[*]Storage containing some items, can no longer be stored into another starage, resulting in losing items inside.
[*]Binding controls to seat, now ends, when player leaves the seat
[/list]

[h3]New:[/h3][list]
[*]Square Window made of steel  looks better, but there might be some rare graphics problems with steel walls, because I am in the middle of adding and sometimes changing ship building parts.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/7364d83cd3f4f59056f9807415cb2c829f9ede71.jpg[/img]

Thank you all very much  for great and detailed Bug Reports,
You are making the game better.

I also welcome reports about stuff you struggled to understand (even when it's not broken)

notes.title: Vehicle & Physics update (Only in BETA)
notes.notes:
Spoiler video about Vehicle Test map:
https://youtu.be/PuFqQgq5h4s

New:[list]
[*]When physical object hits object that is curently static, it might trigger it's physics ON. (depends on mass and force)
[*]When Object is grabbed, or enters physics state, surounding objects go Physics too (unless  connected to building Base, or in zero G), (it creates small chain reaction, hopefully not big one)
[*]Vehicle wheel now triggers physics of parts under it and applies forces (there is a contraption in test level to test this)
[*]Inventory now hides when you sit,
[*]Collectively hated Space Worthy artwork in the menu was replaced with cycling screenshots. New Game menu shows screenshot from selected game mode, so player can see what to expect.
[/list]

Building Changes and Restrictions:[list]
[*]Some parts (like bed, or more advanced crafting tables) can only be used when placed on floor or base . When attaching parts, there is yellow warning, (you can still attach it but part will not work as supposed to, in future update) 
[*]Structural parts can be attached only to other structural parts.
[*]Structural parts can be attached only to parts with same or higher sturdines. (no more stone walls on thatch base)
[*]Immovable parts  (like stone walls or dirt furnace) can only be placed on other Immovable parts, or on planet's surface. (Immovable parts are mostly parts, that cannot enter physics state, or are destroyed when physics state is attempted)
[*]Some primitive parts can only be attached when facing certain directions, relative to gravity. Dirt parts are restricted the most (no vertical rotations), Stone can have vertical rotations ,but by 90 degrees steps. (Materials that can be used to make vehicles have no orientation restrictions)
[*] smooth blending when attaching no longer affects restrictions, and when player decides to place the part, it apears in goal position instantly.
[/list]
[i]Tell me if you found some restriction illogical, or if they are stopping you to build something realistic.[/i]

Bugs Fixed:[list]
[*]Loading Vehicle Test map rarely worked, because planet name was diferent than planet name in other maps (I forgot to make planet's name part of save data. )
[*]Player can no longer break vehicle physics by holding items near/inside the wheels, or jacks.
[*]Vehicle wheel no longer can climb almost 90 degrees slopes
[*]Upside down ladders now respect character's orienntation and work anyway
[/list]

[i]This update is only for BETA Branch of the game
If you are not scared of bugs, you can try BETA!
Go to your Library-> right click on Space Worthy-> Preferences-> Betas
[/i]

notes.title: Wood and Tree Update Part A (Beta)
notes.notes:
Nature Generation:[list]
[*]Pine Trees (must start new game to see them)
[*]Added sphere chunk system, planet surface is segmented into chunks (only when certain nature object needs it)
[*]New nature generator rule for big nature objects: now they cannot spawn inside other big objects, and and can maintain at least some minimal distance to other objects (based on radius value)
[*]New nature generator rule: big nature objects are structly generated inside  imaginary chunks. These chunks cannot leak to other chunks.
[*]Smaller objects do not respect chunks, it gives smoother biome blending (its faster without it)
[*]When you travel, the nature is dissapearing in the same order as it shows
[*]Settings have two sliders for nature view distance
[*]When I added tall pine trees, it was even more obvious that such huge objects should be visible from much larger distance, so I separated nature generation by object size. Nature generator first generates  huge objects, then generating is paused until player is closer, then smaller objects are generated too. Peformance impact is not that drastic, becasue there is not that many large objects like trees and boulders, compared to small objects like small stones or grass. 
[/list]

notes.title: Exploration & survival Update 01
notes.notes:
[u][h2]Scattered debris[/h2][/u]
Survival has scattered debris now, so there is finally a reason to go somewhere.
You can find mostly Steel hull parts, or even storage boxes with some items
Parts are randomly damaged
You can also find escape pods containing ship plans and some small loot (No injured crewmates yet) 


Added Main Stats[list]
[*]Hunger - You can eat food from the inventory
[*]Thirst - no water yet, but some foods have a lot of water inside
[*]Energy - Used for regenerating health. (energy is regenerated by food and water)
[/list]


[u][h2]Cloth[/h2][/u][list]
[*]Can be crafted, (only primitive plant fiber cloth for now)
[*]Cloth occupies predetermined cloth sloths
[*]Is damaged by heavy duty work, like mining (also visual)
[*]Affects wearers stats, like damage resistance,  movement speed (it has a lot effects that do nothing at this moment)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/90633d95108a03aec0904761630bba8130c34e64.jpg[/img]

Cloth slots [list]
[*]Shoes
[*]Bottom
[*]Top
[*]Head
[*]Jacket
[*]Face mask 
[*]Eye mask (or glasses)
[*]Spacesuit Slot
[/list]
Lot of cloth items occupy more than one slot, for example default SpaceWorthy overal is "top" and "bottom".
Cloth can be unequiped at Inventory menu (same as Storage slots)


[u][h2]Stat Effects[/h2][/u]
Effects with delay,  something that I personaly never seen in any other game. For example Drink murky water, thirst is fixed, everything is fine, but there is hidden stat effect waiting to happen, after 3 hours you got sick stomach effect. Or You eat beans,  and you have fart problems tomorow. 
(There is unfortunetly no murky water or farts, yet. I only prepared system for such things.)  Farts could be good way to mess up your stealth. 

You can tell me ideas for funny or interesting stat effects, but It should make some sense. (No drugs, No alcohol)



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/bef7caebc2d5ee4c38bc7a1b057e82e208872f61.jpg[/img]

[u][h2]Added[/h2][/u][list]
[*]Ceramics, crafted at pottery as raw ceramic, then must be baked (like Coke pocket)
[*]Liquid item storage, new ceramic jugs can store liquid as items, can be equiped as backpack
(liquid cannot exist in physical item form, unless its goo liquid like crude oil)
[*]Added Simple Beacon Scanner, only returns value of distance to nearest beacon (all directions). Included in new Navigation Room. Old mighty Beacon Scanner would spoil exploration for beginners, and it's also harder to use.
[*]Chemical lab can now craft two diferent items at the same time, rubber and liquid fuel.
[*]Solid fuel can be crafted and can be filled into solid rocket engine,
[*]Solid rocket engine is crafted empty and can be refilled after its burned. It can be filled partly
[*]Steam engine now needs water.
[*]Added Edible items, berries (grows on bush) and packed food (loot from debris)
[*]Added Sickle tool for non destructive harvesting foliage (it regrows later)
[*]Ship Blueprint Plan item (loot from escape pod debris). When attached to Building manager table, you can spawn planed parts of that structure.
[*]I found out that I actually have to add water on the planet when I already integrated water items into crafting  tree. So there are water lakes, but no collision, no swiming, no drowning, only harvesting water into jug. 
[*]Steel building parts can be demolished and you get some items from them
[*]Contextual info about interaction of selected inventory item, for example "Eat (Right Mouse Button)"
[*]There is more, but I forgot, since it's kind of medium-large update.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228713/3a49923a9bb467248b1a1fc662b7104b3f3c4595.jpg[/img]
